Definition: from G1031; a grating (of the teeth):--gnashing.
BiblicalUsage: brygmós covers the gnashing of teeth, and the Bible uses it the way ordinary people would. You find it 7 times, in Luke among other places, and each time it is doing the same steady work. It is a word you understand best by watching where it goes, not by guessing at it.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple: the gnashing of teeth is part of how God speaks to us, and brygmós is the word He chose for it. That is reason enough to learn it.
